question.worked_solution:
We multiply each term inside the parentheses by the term outside the parentheses, simplify using the rules of exponents, and then we add the results together:

$$
\begin{aligned}2{b}^{3}(-\frac{b}{4}+{b}^{3}-\frac{1}{3}) & = \\ 2{b}^{3}\cdot (-\frac{b}{4})+2{b}^{3}\cdot {b}^{3}+2{b}^{3}\cdot (-\frac{1}{3}) & = \\ (-\frac{1}{2})({b}^{3+1})+2({b}^{3+3})+(-\frac{2}{3}){b}^{3} & = \\ -\frac{1}{2}{b}^{4}+2{b}^{6}-\frac{2}{3}{b}^{3} & = \\ 2{b}^{6}-\frac{1}{2}{b}^{4}-\frac{2}{3}{b}^{3}\end{aligned}
$$
